# Mostik

> Mostik (Мостик) is an unofficial, open-source desktop client for Yandex Telemost chats (Яндекс Телемост, Yandex 360). It runs on Linux (AppImage), Windows (installer) and macOS (Apple Silicon, DMG), is written in Rust with Tauri 2 and Leptos, and is MIT-licensed. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by Yandex LLC.

Mostik talks to the undocumented protocol of the Telemost web client (HTTP RPC plus the Xiva WebSocket) and marks every request with `Mostik/<version>` in the `User-Agent`. Login goes through Yandex ID, including corporate SSO; only the session cookies are stored, in the system keyring (Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows, the login keychain on macOS); during a call they are also in the call window's profile, which on Linux lives in `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` and goes with the call, and on Windows is a private (in-memory) WebView2 profile. Sign-out ends the Yandex ID session and removes the account's local data. Features: channels, groups, Telemost meeting chats, broadcast channels, direct messages, threads, replies and quotes, editing, reactions, sending without sound or as important, long messages sent in parts, voice messages (playback and transcripts), stickers, read receipts (in groups: how many members read a message, and a "Who read it" list of everyone who read or reacted), spell checking in message fields, custom emoji shared between Mostik users through a hidden service chat, file and image upload in chats and threads (also dropped or pasted from the clipboard) with per-file progress and cancel (files over 50 MB go through Yandex Disk, as in the official client), a Files tab listing a chat's files, live updates, unread counts in the sidebar, notifications with do-not-disturb synced with Telemost, tray icon (white or the app icon), statuses, server-side message search across all chats of the organization with filters (important, mine, by sender), Slack keyboard shortcuts (Cmd on macOS, rebindable in Preferences), a sidebar search that also finds public channels you are not in and people you have no chat with, light and dark themes, Russian and English UI, one-click updates from GitHub releases (signed, checked by the Tauri updater), also from the login screen. Calls open in their own window like Slack huddles: on Windows a WebView2 window, on Linux an installed Chromium-based browser in app mode with a throwaway in-memory profile (WebKitGTK has no WebRTC), falling back to the default browser; on macOS a call opens in the default browser.

## Docs

- [README (Russian)](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/blob/HEAD/README.md): features, screenshots, installation, building from source
- [Changelog (Russian)](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md): changes and fixes by release, newest first
- [Design notes](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/blob/HEAD/docs/design.md): layout metrics, colour tokens, typography and behaviour

## Downloads

- [Latest release](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/releases/latest): Linux AppImage, Windows installer, macOS DMG
- [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/releases/latest/download/Mostik_linux_amd64.AppImage): x86-64, glibc 2.39+ (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 or newer, Arch Linux; on Arch it needs `fuse3`)
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/releases/latest/download/Mostik_windows_x64-setup.exe): Windows 10 and 11, x64, per-user install
- [macOS DMG](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/releases/latest/download/Mostik_macos_aarch64.dmg): Apple Silicon only, not notarized
- [Issues](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/issues): bug reports and feature requests

## Source

- [crates/mostik-core](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/crates/mostik-core): domain model, live events, markup parser, demo data
- [crates/mostik-ipc](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/crates/mostik-ipc): contract between the backend and the UI: Tauri commands, their arguments and results
- [crates/mostik-yandex](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/crates/mostik-yandex): Telemost web client protocol
- [app/ui](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/app/ui): Leptos UI compiled to wasm; runs on demo data in a plain browser
- [app/src-tauri](https://github.com/tsarev-i/Mostik/tree/HEAD/app/src-tauri): Tauri 2 desktop shell
